bullets: Expert Command is a chat now, like Simple: your orders as a message, the answer in a card, and the marching orders box pinned at the bottom with the run modes, priority, when, and Free only right in it. While the AIs work, each step, the AI on it and the cost so far show inside the answer card.
A clear New chat button sits at the top of the sidebar in Simple and Expert.

Upgrade to a paid plan from inside the app: an Upgrade button in the title bar on Free, and every Pro feature opens the same box with the plans and buy buttons. Meldmind unlocks by itself when it sees the payment, or you can type a license key.
PowerShell scripts are checked by PowerShell's own reader (never run), so a script that would not work is fixed before it is saved.
The answer check shows in Light mode too, and flags a placeholder left in, such as Hi [Name], in any answer.
The Get free AIs card has a solid background again, and a request for a script about photos no longer makes a picture.
Make changes opens with a short list first, the Saved note no longer covers your buttons, and on a phone the newest reply stays above the chat box.
In practice mode, a follow-up gets its own answer instead of repeating the first one.
